verdict.rationale: Shopify ships an npm-installable UCP CLI with structured commands and a reusable local profile, plus JSON-RPC MCP endpoints authenticated by machine-minted client-credential JWTs. Together these form a scriptable, non-interactive surface, and a runtime probe drove the CLI headlessly to create a real cart. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless documentation (non-interactive flags, exit codes, CI secret/env configuration beyond UCP_ON_ESCALATION), self-serve webhook setup, and independent corroboration of a full automated checkout run.
